title: Jonathan Stahlhacke
//canonifyURLs: Deliberately NOT set. It rewrites every relative URL to an absolute one against baseURL, so on www.porkcullis.com the stylesheet was fetched from the bare domain - cross-origin. That made sheet.cssRules throw SecurityError, so colours.html could not find its @keyframes theme-cycle rule, the colour engine died, and --theme-color stayed at its #fff initial value: white sidebar, white headings, invisible links. Root-relative URLs work on whatever host serves them.
//: Replaces the legacy `indexes` key. Hugo still honours `indexes` as an alias for `taxonomies`, and it was doing real work: restricting taxonomies to tags only. Dropping it silently re-enabled the default `categories` taxonomy and generated a set of empty /categories/ pages.
